summary.en: 8200 EISP, established 2011 as a non-profit by the IDF Unit 8200 Alumni Association, is an equity-free accelerator open to all Israeli startups (not only 8200 alumni). Across 14 cycles it has supported 204 startups raising over $1 billion, with 10 exits.
